title: REAR WINDOW DEFOG EQUIPMENT-CONTENTS
summary: RPO C50 rear window defogger (blower type): contents of the C50 sheets plus the dash switch and wiring. The defogger switch mounts behind the instrument-panel trim panel with two screws and a knob with its own set screw; its wire harness runs along the tunnel and up the side to the blower motor in the rear, with the black ground wire held by a production clip & screw and lock washer, and a purple lead to the radio fuse location at the fuse panel. A capacitor on the motor comes with RPO U69 (radio).

parts.name: WIRE ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Wire assembly – defogger harness, switch to blower motor

parts.name: CAPACITOR ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Capacitor assembly – radio noise suppression capacitor on blower motor (with RPO U69)

fastening.note: View A: two screws [2] go in from the front of the trim panel through two 1/4 dia. holes into the switch [3] bracket behind it.
View A: knob [1] slides onto the switch shaft through a 7/16 dia. hole in the trim panel and is locked by a set screw built into the knob (no separate callout); the knob set screw is torque 2.
Black ground lead of wire [4] fastens to the body with a production clip & screw and lock washer [5].
Clip [6] holds the wire [4] at the blower motor (motor ground wire area; motor itself on sheets A2-A3).
Capacitor [7] sits on the blower motor (U69 only); its fastening is not shown here.

notes: Wire colors shown: BLACK, BROWN, PURPLE.
notes_internal: Title block: UPC C50, sheet A1, model 19400, C/O A1, drawing 3965172, K297. Revision record empty.
Knob torque: the 'triangle 2 + solid square KNOB' callout reads as the knob set screw at torque 2; the set screw is part of the knob [1].
Contents list says A2 = MOTOR & DUCT ASM (19467), A3 = UPPER DUCT & CABLE (19467), but the title blocks of A2/A3 are swapped (p300 A2 = upper duct & cable, p301 A3 = motor & duct).
Wire [4] routing: along the tunnel, past the instrument cluster, up the side to the rear; not traced further.
